exposure: Arterial occlusion methods (uterine or iliac artery ligation, embolization or intravascular balloons)
cohort: 338 women with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) undergoing cesarean delivery at 14 European and one non-European center (USA) between 2008 and 2019
finding: In pregnant women with PAS, the likelihood of blood loss >3500 ml was reduced in planned vs unplanned cesarean delivery, and when the surgery was performed by a specialist experienced in the management of PAS.
